title: Weekly AI Worldview | Shuimu Molecular Near ¥100M Angel; Zhuoshi ¥100M+ B+; Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs Tops $1B
summary: Zhuoshi Tech (卓世科技) — generative LLM firm closes ¥100M+-class B+ led by Shenzhen Cowin; Qingdao Haifa and TusStar follow. Own foundation model + MoE; MaaS-Agent low-code platform; focus eldercare & education digital humans. Founder Tu Jing (ex-Baidu); team from Baidu/Lenovo.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly digest · August 19, 2024

China funding

Zhuoshi Tech (卓世科技) — generative LLM firm closes ¥100M+-class B+ led by Shenzhen Cowin; Qingdao Haifa and TusStar follow. Own foundation model + MoE; MaaS-Agent low-code platform; focus eldercare & education digital humans. Founder Tu Jing (ex-Baidu); team from Baidu/Lenovo. (Lenovo Capital / 联想之星)

Xinyue Intelligence (心跃智能) — AI counseling assistant SaaS; ¥1M+-class seed from angels. Mini-program ~10k registered users; web version planned August; privacy-first; voice UX next. (Company)

Shuimu Molecular (水木分子) — biopharma LLM; near ¥100M angel led by Huashan Capital; Daotong and iFlytek Venture. Funds multimodal models and conversational drug-discovery assistant ChatDD; ChatDD-FM100B on C-Eval; incubated at Tsinghua AIR; partners include Fosun Pharma. (TusStar Online)

Avolution.ai / Luying (鹿影科技) — AI video for anime; angel from BlueRun and Redpoint China. Co-founders Huang Zhaoyang (LCM), Li Qian, Wang Chaoqi; Motion-I2V and AnimateLCM; C-end product YoYo. (36Kr)

Overseas funding

CodeRabbit — AI code review; $16M Series A led by CRV (Flex Capital, Engineering Capital). ~600 paying orgs; Fortune 500 pilots; funds sales/marketing, product, security vuln analysis.

EliseAI — AI property management; $75M Series D at $1B valuation (CEO Minna Song). Chatbots for tours, maintenance, renewals, delinquencies; expand to healthcare scheduling/billing.

Events

Meiqi Interactive (founder Liu Qingsun, ex-Xueersi online GM) takes investment from Northern Light and TAL affiliate; product VALA World for ages 8–12 (AI × education × games).

World Labs (Fei-Fei Li) — NEA leads $100M round; valuation >$1B (from ~$200M in April). Spatial intelligence / 3D physical world models; Li on leave from Stanford through Dec 2025, remains HAI co-director.

Google Pixel 9 series — Gemini default assistant; Tensor G4 + Titan M2; 7 years OS/security updates; Pixel 9 from $799, Pro $999, Pro XL $1,099.

People

Chen Yangyu (ex-ByteDance core tech) founds Qingshan Info for AI / virtual livestream; top USD fund backing; Tencent veterans joining. (Baoliaotai)

— END —
